submissions.title: GSM-Symbolic: Understanding the Limitations of Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
submissions.note: Symbolic templates over GSM8K: accuracy declines when only the numeric values change, and adding one irrelevant but topical clause drops accuracy by up to 65%. Directly on prompt-invariance; the reported drops are the paper's own.

submissions.title: Alice in Wonderland: Simple Tasks Showing Complete Reasoning Breakdown in State-Of-the-Art Large Language Models
submissions.note: Strong performance fluctuations across natural variations of one problem template that change neither structure nor difficulty, with confident confabulated justifications. Same axis, different instrument family.

submissions.title: Language models, like humans, show content effects on reasoning tasks
submissions.note: Humans and models tested on the same three logic tasks; both show content effects, but the Wason selection task splits them - humans do much worse than large models and err differently. A bridge paper: both sides measured in one study.
